name: spindle-production-waf-custom
description: Custom WAF rules for the spindle.app zone. See docs/security/waf-rules.md for the rule table, rollout plan, and false-positive handling. Deploy after reviewing that document; the geo rule ships disabled.

rules.description: Block requests whose Host header is not one of the hostnames this zone serves. The tunnel already 404s unknown names; this is a second layer for DNS-level or direct-IP probes.
Block well-known scanner and CMS probe paths. The Next.js app serves no .php, wp-*, .git, .env, or cgi-bin content, so none of these can be legitimate.

rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path contains "..") or (http.request.uri.query contains "..%2f") or (http.request.uri.query contains "%2e%2e") or (http.request.uri.query contains "%252e")
rules.description: Block path traversal probes, including double-encoded variants.

rules.expression: (http.user_agent contains "sqlmap") or (http.user_agent contains "nikto") or (http.user_agent contains "nmap") or (http.user_agent contains "masscan") or (http.user_agent contains "zgrab")
rules.description: Block requests advertising known scanner tooling in the User-Agent.
Managed challenge for IPs Cloudflare scores as high-threat (threat score below 10). Legitimate users solve it once per session; bots rarely do.
Challenge non-standard HTTP methods and POSTs with an empty User-Agent (a common bot signature). WebSocket upgrades use GET, so they are unaffected.

PLACEHOLDER geo rule (ships disabled). Set the country set to match the sanctioned-country policy in docs/security/waf-rules.md before enabling. 'challenge' not 'block' keeps the blast radius small while the list is tuned.
